37. 考慮以下的不等式組：

\[\begin{cases}
x \ge 2,\\
y \ge 0,\\
x + 4y \le 22,\\
4x - y \le 20
\end{cases}\]

設 $D$ 為表示以上的不等式組的解之區域。若 $(x, y)$ 為 $D$ 中的一點，則 $3y - 4x + 15$ 的最大值為

A. 3。
B. 17。
C. 22。
D. 30。
reasoning: The feasible region D defined by x\ge2, y\ge0, x+4y\le22 and 4x-y\le20 is a convex quadrilateral with vertices (2,0), (5,0), (6,4) and (2,5). Evaluating the linear objective f(x,y)=3y-4x+15 at these vertices gives f(2,0)=7, f(5,0)=-5, f(6,4)=3, and f(2,5)=22. Since the region is bounded, the maximum of the linear function occurs at a vertex, thus the maximum value is 22, which corresponds to option C.
